name: p25_recipe_parity_loeo_f0
title: Biohub P25 Recipe Parity LOEO F0
purpose: RECIPE PARITY (LEVER-0023 sizing, PKT-0019): can the July training recipe reproduce the public split_0 quality? The champion configuration (P9 coupled division on the P3 harmonic base, FACT-0322) retargeted at LOEO fold 0 (44b6 held out, 71 crops) with ONE change: the PRIMARY edge weights are OUR out-of-fold split_0 (aryaarun07/biohub-oof-weights edge_predictor_best_split_0.pth, 8,357,783 bytes, sha256 d3e89eb361eeadef..., trained on 6bba only) instead of the pack's split_0 (pilkwang/biohub-tracking-support-pack-50ep-v1 weights/unet_transformer/split_0/edge_predictor_best.pth, 8,363,159 bytes, sha256 12f6881ee3620a83...). Both are clean on fold 0 by construction (loeo_retarget.py: the pack ships only split_0, trained on 6bba). The two have never been compared on the same pipeline and crops. Its export is scored against the EXP-0022 control (C:/temp/p20_relink_sweep_f0/sweep_pen_off.csv.gz = pack split_0 on this exact configuration, FACT-0322) with the FACT-0321 paired instrument (scripts/win_bet/ea_atlas.py + tracking_cellmot summarise(), crop bootstrap over the same 71 crops). PRE-REGISTERED READING: if our split_0 lands within the fold-0 paired MDE (FACT-0263) of the pack's, the July recipe reproduces the public quality and continued training on it is credible; if it is more than 0.01 below, the recipe/compute is the bottleneck and LEVER-0023 must budget for closing that gap before any architecture work. Both embryo directions are reported separately as always; this spec is fold 0 only. ~2.7 GPU-hours, zero submissions. NOT a scientific verdict on LEVER-0023 and NOT a submission.
